2403-4279-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2403-4279-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4279-5332-5687--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5332-5687--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5670-6559.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5670-6559.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2023-3480-4518-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-5100-5256.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5100-5256.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1870-4873-5087-7170.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
1870-4873-5087-7170.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield at instant speed.
There is at least one counter of any kind on The Ozolith.
1870-4873-5087-7170.description:
At the beginning of combat, Living Brain and The Ozolith trigger.
Resolve the Living Brain trigger, making Eternity Vessel a creature.
In response to the remaining trigger, cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
Resolve The Ozolith trigger from step 1, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

1170-1636-7524-7875.easyPrerequisites: Rocket Volley must have valid targets.
1170-1636-7524-7875.description:
Cast Rocket Volley using Party Thrasher's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Maelstrom Artisan.
When Maelstrom Artisan enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

301-4535-7861.description:
Activate Clickslither by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Clickslither ability.
Repeat.

4636-5770-6441-7824.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

5035-5104-5231.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
5035-5104-5231.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

4824-6287-7704.notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness and has power 6 or greater.
Soliton and Doc Samson are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
4824-6287-7704.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Doc Samson.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Soliton.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2232-3558-4541-5705.manaNeeded: {1} if you control fewer than eight Treasures
2232-3558-4541-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Treasures.
2232-3558-4541-5705.description:
Activate at least seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {7}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {7} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {1} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying its mana cost.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
2232-3558-4541-5705.notes: If you control eight or more Treasures, use eight Treasures to cast Marut, which foregoes step 12.

240-719-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Xenograft, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-719-2292.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

4899-7362.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
4899-7362.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the exiled card's mana value.
Casey's second ability triggers, and Phyrexian Devourer triggers if it's power is 7 or greater.
Resolve the Casey trigger, dealing damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1 until your library.
Resolve all Phyrexian Devourer triggers, sacrificing it.

1734-2511-5987.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Sailor of Means

1409-1418-5424.description:
Activate Sailor of Means by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sailor of Means enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Sailor of Means.
Resolve both Sailor of Means triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

339-677-997-7060.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1414-2866-4986-5686.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

147-3967-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3967-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3967-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-2897-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Gigantoplasm.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Gigantoplasm by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1339-2034-2122-3129.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2034-2122-3129.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1170-1636-1645.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {R}{R}.
1170-1636-1645.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {R}{R}.
Cast Crown of Flames by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control except Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking itself.
When Displacer Kitten enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4826-5411-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Archelos is untapped.
4826-5411-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

539-2762-4552.notablePrerequisites: Thopter Squadron has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
539-2762-4552.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron.
Repeat.

352-2092-4539.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one additional card in hand.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
352-2092-4539.description:
Cast Unexpected Windfall by paying {2}{R}{R} and discarding a card.
Holding priority, activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {U}{R}, copying Unexpected Windfall.
Resolve the copy of Unexpected Windfall, creating two Treasure artifact tokens and causing you to draw two cards.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2092-2810-4385-4587.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
2092-2810-4385-4587.description:
Activate Silver Queen by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate the Sliver token by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2-198-1651-1770.notablePrerequisites:
Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the number of charge counters on Empowered Autogenerator minus three.
2-198-1651-1770.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
